### 2026-10-06 — I worked on the starbie project, My laptop is potato so I had to setup kicad on github codespace, which acted up often, I didn't include the time in log where is acted up. I mainly followed the tutori

**2.5h**

I worked on the starbie project, My laptop is potato so I had to setup kicad on github codespace, which acted up often, I didn't include the time in log where is acted up. I mainly followed the tutorial. I know this shouldn't havetaken me this long, but acting up of codespace, then setting the codespace really burned through my time. It wont count towards my logged time but still it is the time I spent. Then in the tutorial, when I started building I noticed some green lines, it took me whole 30 minutes to find that to add those lines I just need to press W, then everything else went smoothly, though I had to retry this project 2 times before the third time I actually was able to build it. This mainly happened because absence of things like SW_PUSH type things in my kicad env, IDK why but it wasn't present, then i fixed the devcontainer because I had ai generated it, thn I again started and it worked. SO yeah... that sums everything up, yes Ik it is more time than you would expect one to take for task like this but you can check the GitHub repo and the dev container files, theirpushes to understadn my struggle

### 2026-10-07 — So today I completed the PCB ROUTING! It took me a longer than expected because the its my first time trying to do the PCB routing. When converting to PCB editor I forgot to add footprints, then that

**1.5h**

So today I completed the PCB ROUTING! It took me a longer than expected because the its my first time trying to do the PCB routing. When converting to PCB editor I forgot to add footprints, then that took a solid 5 minutes, ik very little time but it was the most frustruating time, otherwise everything went smoothly, I didn't run into much errors or anything, it went cools with me. It was kinda fun too. I learned something not mentioned in the tutorial, I can upload images and use it to trace out the shape, I didn't Google that up I promise! I discovered it by accident after I thought that the image button helps me add a prebuilt image, so I foolishly screenshoted the tutorial's image and added it there. I decide to stop and compete the project later as I am currently have caught a cold and fever and its draining the energy out of me. Bye! bye!
